# Terry Wang

> Terry Wang (also Tianyu Wang) is a software engineer at Cresta, previously a
> software engineer at Google for four years. He holds a Bachelor of Computer
> Science from the University of Waterloo and is based in Canada.

Personal site: https://tianyu.wang/

## Current

- **Cresta** - Software Engineer, December 2025 to present. Remote, Canada.

## Previous

- **Google** - Software Engineer II to III, August 2021 to October 2025.
  Kitchener, Ontario, Canada and Los Angeles, California, United States. Worked
  on Google Cloud Billing Console: Angular UI and middle-layer migrations, and
  data resource models for a public cloud pricing API.
- **Ritual** - Software Engineer Intern, September to December 2020. Toronto,
  Ontario, Canada.
- **Google** - Software Engineer Intern, May to August 2020. Mountain View,
  California, United States. Contributed zPages to the OpenTelemetry Java SDK.
- **Deloitte** - Software Engineer Intern, January to April 2019. Kitchener,
  Ontario, Canada.
- **Finastra** - Software Engineer Intern, May to August 2018. Toronto, Ontario,
  Canada.

## Education

- **University of Waterloo** - Bachelor of Computer Science, September 2016 to
  April 2021. Waterloo, Ontario, Canada.

## Skills

TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Angular, Node.js, Python, Java, and web
performance work.
